access: Local processes only. Listing tools is read-only; calling a tool requires approval. Adding an MCP server means trusting a program to run on this PC — the first use of each server configuration is approved by the owner at the gate, and any change to its command or arguments is approved again.
description: Bridge to locally-run MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers declared in connectors.json — their tools become the agent's tools.
name: MCP Servers

tools.description: List the tools a configured local MCP server exposes.
tools.name: mcp_list_tools

tools.description: Call one tool on a configured local MCP server.
tools.name: mcp_call

arguments_json.description: Tool arguments as a JSON object string
